content.title: Chapter 58 - MUNICIPAL COURT — Sec. 58-5. - Delivery.
content.summary:
A subpoena or other process of the municipal court issued pursuant to this chapter
               may be served by delivering a copy personally or mailing by first class mail the subpoena
               to the last known address of the person named in such subpoena or other process.
